name: Obsidian
tagline: A powerful markdown note-taking app that lives on your local machine.
description: Obsidian is a powerful knowledge base on top of a local folder of plain text Markdown files. It is extremely fast, fully offline, and lets you build your personal second brain using deep text connections and interactive graph maps.
features: Local-first markdown files for complete data ownership
Interactive knowledge Graph View with group color filters
Rich community plugin market with hundreds of add-ons
Canvas whiteboard mode for visual card mind mapping
